summary: Momentus Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of 2,173,420 shares of Class A common stock at $8.50 per share and pre-funded warrants for 768,580 shares, raising about $25 million in gross proceeds. The transaction closed on May 28, 2026. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment and working capital. The filing includes customary representations, warranties, and a lock-up restriction on future issuances until 5 days after a resale registration statement becomes effective. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
